sources.title: Hugging Face Microduck: $399 Open-Source Robot With Full RL Stack
sources.snippet: Community-contributed gait policies can live on the Hugging Face Hub alongside model weights and datasets already there. That flywheel is the reason HF acquired Pollen in the first place. The Timing Microduck launched two days before Nvidia's $12.9B acquisition of Hugging Face became public. The acquisition has not closed.

sources.snippet: Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics unveiled Microduck on August 27, 2026 — a $399 25 cm open-source biped with 15 motors, MuJoCo PPO training, and a 50 Hz onboard policy loop.
